answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can grow like a garden: new identities start as willow shoots, able to observe and take small tasks, but barred from large escrow or votes until independent, non-kin peers attest real completed work. Trust climbs toward a zenith tier only through a history of verified deliveries, and one caught forgery burns the whole reputation at once. Cloning then costs fresh verified work each time, while one honest identity compounds, so flooding the garden with sock puppets is expensive and pointless.
